subject: HAM-DFW one oversized piece
body:
Hello,

please quote Hamburg (HAM) to Dallas (DFW) for 1 turbine housing on a skid, 300 kg, 320 x 150 x 25 cm (1.2 cbm), delivered to HAM by us, ready 27.11. The piece is longer than 300 cm, so it needs a carrier that can load it. Cheapest option, EUR.
